import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 分离本命物指令
 * /分离      → 显示确认提示
 * /分离 确认 → 执行分离
 */
import App from '@src/response-apps/soulArtifact/unequip/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const isConfirmed = /确认/.test(text);

  // A level-zero artifact executes immediately on the first command, so carry
  // the platform write identity for both branches.  The App only consumes it
  // when it actually invokes the mutation.
  const result = await App({ messageText: e.MessageText, bid, uid, confirmed: isConfirmed, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

  if (result.code === 'NOT_EQUIPPED') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  if (result.code === 'CONFIRM') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('⚠️ 分离本命物确认');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`本命物：${result.data.name}`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`当前等级：Lv.${result.data.level}`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`投入筑灵石：${result.data.totalCost}`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`退还筑灵石：${result.data.refundQty}（60%）`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('分离后等级将重置为 Lv.0，品级和洗涤附加保留');

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '',
        content: md,
        footer: [
          { label: '确认分离', command: '/分离 确认' },
          { label: '取消', command: '/储物袋 本命' }
        ]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  const displayMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, createBackendRequestContext(e));

  md.addText(displayMsg);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addButton('储物袋 · 本命', { data: '/储物袋 本命' });

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
});
